import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Cutting {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int b = sc.nextInt();

        int[] a = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextInt();
        }

        int[] oddCount = new int[n];
        int[] evenCount = new int[n];

        if (a[0] % 2 == 0) {
            evenCount[0] = 1;
        } else {
            oddCount[0] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            if (a[i] % 2 == 0) {
                evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1] + 1;
                oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1];
            } else {
                oddCount[i] = oddCount[i - 1] + 1;
                evenCount[i] = evenCount[i - 1];
            }
        }

        ArrayList<Integer> costs = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) {
            if (evenCount[i] == oddCount[i]) {
                costs.add(Math.abs(a[i] - a[i + 1]));
            }
        }

        Collections.sort(costs);
        int totalUsed = 0, cutsMade = 0;
        for (int cost : costs) {
            if (totalUsed + cost <= b) {
                totalUsed += cost;
                cutsMade++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(cutsMade);
    }
}
